title: validateApp requires owner; pass package.json team from core-shell, billing, reports

summary: validateApp now throws if owner missing/empty (non-string/blank too). core-shell, billing, reports pass owner from their package.json team (platform, payments, insights) — hardcoded literals, not read at runtime, since bundles inline sources. platform-kit doesn't use validateApp so no change there. All three apps built locally; CI and CD green. Reports app isn't covered by CI/CD build lists, so its deploy is not exercised by the pipeline.
